description: This file contains end-to-end test harness functions and mock setups for testing reply directive behaviors in an OpenClaw project, including configuration helpers, mock implementations, and test setup/teardown functions.

methods.name: replyText
methods.description: Extracts a string reply from a ReplyPayloadText or array of such payloads.

methods.name: replyTexts
methods.description: Converts ReplyPayloadText or array of such into an array of text strings, filtering out non-string entries.

methods.name: makeEmbeddedTextResult
methods.description: Creates a mock embedded text result object with specified text.

methods.name: mockEmbeddedTextResult
methods.description: Mocks the embedded Pi agent to resolve with a specified embedded text result.

methods.name: withTempHome
methods.description: Runs a function within a temporary home directory context, setting environment variables.

methods.name: sessionStorePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the session store JSON file within a given home directory.

methods.name: makeWhatsAppDirectiveConfig
methods.description: Generates configuration object for WhatsApp directive with defaults and extra parameters.

methods.name: makeElevatedDirectiveConfig
methods.description: Creates a configuration object for elevated directives with specific model and tools settings.

methods.name: assertModelSelection
methods.description: Asserts that the session store at a given path has the expected model and provider override.

methods.name: assertElevatedOffStatusReply
methods.description: Checks that the reply text indicates elevated mode is disabled and contains specific formatting.

methods.name: installDirectiveBehaviorE2EHooks
methods.description: Sets up beforeEach and afterEach hooks for E2E tests, resetting mocks and state.

methods.name: installFreshDirectiveBehaviorReplyMocks
methods.description: Mocks embedded Pi agent functions and reply run functions for testing.

methods.name: makeRestrictedElevatedDisabledConfig
methods.description: Creates a configuration object with elevated mode disabled for specific tools.
